title: Filing: Sergey Brin donated an additional $20M to Building a Better California, which fights California's wealth tax, bringing his total contributions to $102M (Alicia Clanton/Bloomberg)
summary: Alicia Clanton / Bloomberg: Filing: Sergey Brin donated an additional $20M to Building a Better California, which fights California's wealth tax, bringing his total contributions to $102M — Billionaire Sergey Brin has now poured over $100 million into his fight to stop a wealth tax in California.
